A Community Chest card would mostly be harmless, offering only cash, a jail visit, or repairs.

Building four houses instead would raise the average to about ninety-three dollars, with Virginia alone paying one hundred eighty dollars when hit.

Player three can exit jail and land on Virginia Avenue with a roll of four, which is the most probable pink-property landing. Player three cannot reach St. Charles in one roll, so Virginia is the only immediate threat.

Unmortgaging Illinois Avenue is not worthwhile. Player one owns Kentucky, so the property would not complete a monopoly, and the cost of one hundred thirty-two dollars exceeds the twenty-dollar rent gain.

No trades are viable. Player one would use cash to build fourth houses and destroy the board. Player three has no useful assets. Player four already owns light blue with hotels and would be catastrophic with another orange monopoly. I will mortgage and build without trading.
